name: kenessos, priest of thassa
mana cost: {1}{U}
types: legendary creature merfolk cleric
power toughness: 1/3
activated[1]: {3}{G/U}: look at the top card of your library. if it's a kraken, leviathan, octopus, or serpent creature card, you may put it onto the battlefield. if you don't put the card onto the battlefield, you may put it on the bottom of your library.
replacement: if you would scry a number of cards, scry that many cards plus one instead.
